incident-bot: :pager: PAGE: model-worker-proxy-oom on prod-eu-1 - 1898765432 - severity: P2. Auto-retry triggered, 3 failures in 5m. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/proxy-oom
Maya Chen: I’m on PTO today but saw the page on my phone. I’m the scheduled primary for sunrise EU window. I can’t take the bridge, but I can help with instructions if someone picks up. :wave:
Dennis R.: I’m in US-East. I can try to cover as secondary for the next 30m, but timezone diff means I might hit my limit. primary/secondary?
Maya Chen: Primary was me, secondary was Samir. Samir is listed as EU backup but I think he’s on call tomorrow morning (local). We’ve got a coverage gap for the first 45m of EU sunrise.
Samir Patel: I’m not on call until 0200 UTC, I’m still asleep rn. I can be available in ~90m. Not ideal.
Li Wei: I can take a short handoff — I’m in APAC and available for the next 2 hours. Can take bridge + pager. Noted: this is a weekend rotation and I don’t have the dedicated VPN set up for private runs, will use console.
Maya Chen: Li would you be primary for the mitigation window? If yes, I’ll transfer privileges and share short runbook pointers.
Li Wei: Yes, I’ll take primary for the next 90m. Please hand off.
Maya Chen: Ok Li — handing off. Quick runbook highlights (paste from doc):
```
1) Check pod restarts: kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-proxy -o wide
2) Look for OOMKilled or CrashLoopBackOff
3) If pod is OOM, safe restart we use: kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/model-proxy
4) If restart fails, scale down to 0 then scale up, collect logs: kubectl -n inference logs deploy/model-proxy -c proxy --since=10m
5) If behavior repeats, switch routing to model-proxy-legacy (rollback): /ops/toggle-route --to legacy
6) If >15m impact, call eng-infra on-call and open bridge: /incident open-bridge --svc model-proxy
```
Maya Chen: TL;DR: try restart first, collect logs, fallback to legacy routing if repeat.
Dennis R.: Noted. Li, for auth to run those commands you need kube sudo token — I'll DM you the short-lifetime key and add you to the temporary role. @ops-rotation-bot can you confirm automatic escalation window is 15m for P2?
ops-rotation-bot: Automatic escalation for P2 fires at 18 minutes if unresolved. Next escalation goes to infra-senior.
Li Wei: Got the token from Dennis, joining bridge now.
Li Wei: Running checks: pods show 4/6 ready, 2 x model-proxy-abc OOMKilled in last 7m. Fetching logs.
Li Wei: Logs show repeated allocation spike during cold-start for the v2 model. Pattern: memory growth to 14Gi then OOM.
Samir Patel: If it’s v2 cold-start, we have an alternative: revert to v1 config with lower seq_length and smaller kv cache. That’s the safe fallback.
Li Wei: Trying rollout restart now. Command: kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/model-proxy
Li Wei: Restart kicked, pods coming up. Observing token latency to model is high but healthy.
Maya Chen: Good. Can you confirm customer impact? Any 5xxs or user-facing rate-limited incidents?
Li Wei: Brief spike in 5xxs for EU customers between 1898765400-1898765480 (~80s) — roughly 2.3% of traffic affected. No billing alerts yet.
Dennis R.: Noting customer impact. If it stays below 5% and fixed, we’ll treat as mitigated P2. Please add notes to the incident doc and mark timeline.
Li Wei: Putting a short timeline in the incident doc now: https://redwood.incidents/INC-1898. Adding logs and the pod events.
Maya Chen: Thanks Li — I’ll follow up tomorrow morning (my local) with a post-check and drive a deeper root cause on warmup memory. For now, Li is primary and Dennis is backup. Samir on delayed support.
Samir Patel: will do a follow-up when I’m up. Suggest we schedule an extra rotation rehearsal for cold-starts next week.
Li Wei: Bridge closed in 27m if no regression. Will monitor and ping if anything changes.
Dennis R.: Thanks all — great pickup. One operational note: add a small playbook entry to avoid relying on single primary at sunrise; we need an explicit APAC cross-cover rule for weekend rotations.
Maya Chen: Filed follow-up task: https://redwood.tasks/TSK-4127 "sunrise-crosscover-weekend".
incident-bot: incident INC-1898 transitioned to Mitigated by Li Wei at 1898765648. Severity remains P2 pending RCA. :white_check_mark:
Li Wei: signing off in 5m, leaving monitoring to Dennis for next 30m.
Dennis R.: I’ll stay on until 1898765650 then hand back. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
